provider: RUVDS "Большой диск" / СХД — Russian flat-rate disk VPS with unlimited traffic

free_tier.stated: СХД Старт 1,023 ₽/mo for 1,024 GB; СХД Стандарт 1,899 ₽/mo for 2,048 GB; СХД Премиум 3,798 ₽/mo for 4,096 GB. Line advertised «от 1 до 18 Терабайт». Landing headline: «всего 500₽ за 1 Тб/мес».

egress.terms: Unlimited — every СХД configuration lists its channel (up to 100 Mbit/s on the entry tiers) with no traffic meter, and the service is sold as a VPS so the rail is the VPS's own port. No per-GB charge exists.

tooling: Full KVM VPS: SSH, SFTP, rsync, rclone, MinIO/Nextcloud self-hosted, NFS/Samba.
chaining: Config-doubling ladder up to 18 TB; 20 TB requires two units or a different product. Each 1 TB step costs the same per TB from 2 TB upward.
limits_note: The «500 ₽ per 1 TB/mo» headline is NOT the price of the СХД plans — the cheapest actual 1 TB plan is 1,023 ₽. The 500 ₽ figure refers to a base VPS plus a per-TB disk add-on in the order configurator, and reproducing it requires assembling that configuration.
reliability_note: Long-established Russian host (ruvds.com), KVM, own DCs. No independent benchmark of the СХД disk subsystem was found.

evidence.proved: «Классический VPS с облачным хранилищем всего 500₽ за 1 Тб/мес»; «СХД Старт 1 023 ₽ в месяц» with «hugeDriveCapacity=1024»; «СХД Стандарт 1 899 ₽» (2048); «СХД Премиум 3 798 ₽» (4096)
same page — «полноценное хранилище (СХД) размером от 1 до 18 Терабайт со всем привычным функционалом VPS-сервера»
used only as the FX/units sanity check; RUVDS figures converted at 0.012111 USD/RUB

price_per_tb_month: $11.50/TB/mo at 2 TB ($23.00/mo) and 4 TB ($46.00/mo); $12.39/TB/mo at 1 TB ($12.39/mo). At 20 TB: ~$11.50/TB/mo if two 10 TB-class configs are assembled ($230/mo), derived not quoted. Unlimited traffic, $0 egress.
